document.abstract: The paper will look at the challenge facing ENG users as they are forced to move to digital and the problems of implementing digital ENG in a multipath environment. It will also consider the practical use of multi carrier modulation schemes to overcome these problems and we will present results of tests carried out at Channel 9 in Melbourne to prove the benefits to be had by adopting such as scheme.

authors.bio: Noel Matthews has been with for NDS for nearly 5 years, having first joined the company as MPEG-2 Product Line Manager when the company was then known as NTL. In his role of New Business Development Manager, Noel is responsible for bringing practical applications of new technology to the marketplace. He has most recently been responsible for the market and product development of NDS's OFDM based ENG system which was been officially launched at NAB 1999. Before working for NDS, Noel was involved in the mobile phone and paging market both as an engineer and more recently as a marketing manager.
